entities.name: Dušan Vujović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dušan Vujović was a Serbian economist and politician. He served as the Minister of Finance in the Government of Serbia from 2014 to 2018. He also had short terms as acting Minister of Economy in 2014 and as acting Minister of Defence in 2016. Vujović was a supporter of keynesianism.
